judge.rationale: The candidate only added a `.lore/dod.md` file and an acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code, types, specs, or documentation. Because none of the types (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `UNSUPPORTED`, `history` server option) or handler logic were implemented, the added test file will fail both TypeScript compilation (`as HalServerOptions` bypasses one check, but `frame.type === 'conversation_list'` fails union narrowing on `OutgoingMessage`) and runtime execution. All production requirements from the ticket—updating `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, `StoreCannotList`, specs, and docs—are completely missing.
